description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named 'HelloController' providing basic endpoints including welcome, API documentation redirection, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for greeting, redirecting to Swagger UI documentation, and returning application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests at root ("/") and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests at "/docs", redirects to Swagger UI page, preserving request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests at "/api/info" and returns application information.
